hook: Oral cancer isn't just a smoker's disease
caption: Most people still picture a heavy smoker when they think of oral cancer. The reality looks different. HPV is now responsible for the majority of oropharyngeal cancers in adults under 50, and roughly 1 in 4 cases occur in people with no obvious risk factor at all. That gap between assumption and fact is exactly why so many cases get caught late. Knowing your actual risk takes about two minutes. Take the free screener at oralcheck.org.
